title: Fail closed on malformed preset libraries
summary: Remediate AUDIT-FIND-W02-009 by rejecting malformed persisted preset-library state before any replacement write.
reason: The loader silently converts malformed records to an empty collection, allowing the next ordinary save to atomically erase prior preset content.
behavior_before: Unsupported records shapes and non-object entries are silently discarded, and save trusts the lossy normalized result as complete authority.
behavior_after: Unsupported library versions, malformed records collections or entries, invalid record payloads, and duplicate IDs block reads and writes with actionable recovery evidence while preserving the exact existing bytes.
tests_added: atomic replacement failure preserves the existing library and removes its temporary file
invalid persisted PresetV2 and duplicate IDs fail closed
malformed records object blocks list/save and preserves exact bytes
mixed invalid record entries cannot be silently dropped
manual_validation: Architecture guardrails passed across 218 creation candidates

rollback_plan: Revert only the strict preset-library parser, focused temporary-state tests, and generated artifacts; no stored library migration is performed by this batch.
notes:
The persistence and settings boundaries were reviewed before editing. This batch intentionally provides no automatic migration: unknown bytes remain untouched for operator recovery. No real media is required. Existing Batch 002 partial-preset-apply changes in the same source and test paths are preserved.
Both implementation and test paths already contain preserved Batch 002 partial-preset-apply changes; Batch 050 changes only persisted-library parsing, recovery evidence, and malformed-state/atomic-write coverage.
